independence: Reviewer authored core decomposition; did not author feature stages. Read-only feature review; fixes made by feature author.
scope: Feature scope, reviewer readability, header/test dependency boundaries, shared-family padding/delegation, and named argument borrowing.

findings.finding: Missing closing }; after fmt::formatter<legacy_point> left following namespaces inside a class.
findings.resolution: Feature author corrected extraction boundary and reformatted; reviewer re-inspected closing specialization and top-level namespaces.

findings.finding: Named docs explain runtime validation, but direct suite initially covered only successful name lookup/mutability.
findings.resolution: Author added missing-name, incompatible named spec, negative named width, and nonintegral named width tests, checking status and untouched output.

findings.finding: Shared-family direct suite tested one-pass pointer output and streaming rejection but omitted replayable streaming success.
findings.resolution: Author added right/center replayable streaming tests with exact output/counts and two invocations.

findings.finding: Every stage source-provenance field repeated an unrelated family lambda rename.
findings.resolution: Author narrowed provenance statements to actual per-feature changes.

assessment.scope: Independent named/ranges/chrono/std/styling branches now make coherent family decisions; cross-feature named ranges/std fixtures live in integration stage.
assessment.readability: Headers use conventional formatting. Tests have named behavior functions and explicit expected output/error assertions. Shared helper imports only base + fmt support, without optional families.
assessment.lifetime: args.hpp and docs correctly state borrowed name characters/value references, with temporaries safe only through the formatting full expression.
assessment.padding: Shared-family PR includes its required bounded pointer padding/delegation hooks and documents the replay tradeoff. Pointer prefix reordering has explicit capacity/overflow checks.

validation_limitations: This is independent static source review, not compiler/runtime validation. Root CPU validation must run the assembled intermediate commits before publication. No new algorithm defect is asserted.
